## Learning goals

Complete the exercises below using `fpp3`. Show plots and short written interpretations.

## Setup

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```


## 1. Tournament

```{r}
fit <- aus_production |>
  model(
    holt = ETS(Beer ~ error("A") + trend("A") + season("N")),
    hw = ETS(Beer ~ error("A") + trend("A") + season("A")),
    auto = ETS(Beer)
  )
```

## 2. Components and residuals

```{r}
fit |> select(hw) |> components() |> autoplot()
fit |> gg_tsresiduals()
```

## 3. Decision

Which model would you take to forecasting? Cite residual ACF + AICc.
